tools.name: search_drugs
tools.description: Search the drug boards by free text and by field.

tools.name: get_drug
tools.description:
Full record for one drug, with its efficacy figures estimand-tagged and its page URL.

Matching goes slug, then exact name or brand, then substring, so "wegovy", "Wegovy HD" and
"semaglutide-obesity" all land somewhere sensible without the caller knowing the slug scheme.

tools.name: get_trial
tools.description: One trial's design, by NCT number or by trial key (SURMOUNT-1, scale, redefine-1).

tools.name: compare_efficacy
tools.description:
The extracted weight-loss table for the named drugs, joined to trial design, one row per arm and timepoint.

Rows are NOT collapsed to one number per drug. The corpus holds several doses, timepoints and
estimands per trial, and picking a single winner per drug would mean choosing between them
here,

tools.name: get_adverse_events
tools.description:
Extracted adverse-event rates for a named drug or trial, by arm, with the arithmetic that was checked.

`verification` is carried through verbatim. It is the raw-count recomputation recorded when the
row was extracted ("997/2481 active = 40.18%"), and it is what lets a caller see that the

tools.name: get_trajectory
tools.description:
The digitised weight-loss curve for a drug: week-by-week points, plus per-dose series.

Returned with `endpoint_pct` and its estimand alongside the curve, because the endpoint marker
and the last plotted point are different quantities and the curve alone does not say which one
a reader is looking at
